_README: Single source of truth for the Keep The Record campaign band. ubuntu-markets.org, legacytable.app and heykindred.org all read THIS file. Edit here and only here. Set visible:false to remove the band from every site without deleting anything.
_status_options: upcoming | live | judging | closed. Past endDate the band treats itself as judging even if this is not changed.
name: Keep The Record
body: Cook the recipe with the elder who holds it. Plan the gathering that brings everyone home. Post it, tag it, and you're in the running — $1,000 across three families, with winners announced December 18.
_dates: endDate is the one deadline: enrolment AND final entry close Dec 6 2026, 11:59pm PT. Voting Dec 8-14, winners Dec 18. Must match legacytable.app/keeptherecord.

lanes.title: Set the table
lanes.what: Cook a recipe you've saved in Legacy Table with the elder who taught it. Film it. Tag it.

lanes.title: Call the gathering
lanes.what: Plan a gathering in Kindred and bring your people in. Show us the room you built.

eligibility: Open worldwide to paid members of Legacy Table or heyKindred. One entry per person, per lane.

offer.text: Not a member yet? Founding-family pricing with code

closedMessage: Entries are closed. Winners announced December 18 — watch @heykindred and the Village Journal.
